correctness.rationale: Full 16-arc enumeration and acyclic matching on 260 nonempty faces; all 704 covers checked. Exact integer Morse differential has rank-one primitive d2 and vanishing d3, with 1,1,20,8 critical cells. Elementary CW cancellation and degree-two Hurewicz prove wedge of 19 S2 and 8 S3. An independent finite-chain calculation gives boundary ranks 15,61,40 mod 2. Exact action on 8-dimensional top rational kernel via mod 101 with rigorously justified integral trace lifting, plus signed Lefschetz, proves the complete D4 characters.

value.rationale: This determines a natural finite test case obtained by adding a universal hub to the bidirected four-cycle, whose published homotopy theory is active. The mixed dimensional integral sphere wedge and regular top dihedral module, together with three invariant degree-two classes, give structural information unobtainable from the polygon results or Betti numbers alone. Finite scope is mathematically motivated, with explicit limitations.
